title: George H.W. Bush says public not ready for UFO truth

tellings.quote: he starts going off about how you know the American public is not ready for the truth on UFOs which is definitely offs script from what he would usually say

plain: At one of his son Jeb Bush's campaign events, around 2015 or 2016, former president George H. W. Bush is said to have started talking about how the American public is not ready for the truth about UFOs. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. He stresses that the remark was clearly off script for Bush, and he takes it as a hint that a former president knew more than he usually said.
